concepts.description: A function returned from useEffect that React runs before the next effect and on unmount, used to cancel timers, requests and subscriptions so stale work cannot fire.
concepts.context: SearchBox.tsx returns a cleanup that calls clearTimeout(timer) and controller.abort(), so each keystroke cancels the previous pending search

concepts.description: When overlapping async requests resolve out of order, an older response can overwrite a newer one; fixed by cancelling or ignoring superseded requests.
concepts.context: Aborting the previous request in the effect cleanup in SearchBox.tsx stops a slow response for 'ab' from calling onResults after the response for 'abc'

concepts.description: The dependency array decides when an effect re-runs; an unstable callback prop in it can cause the effect to restart on every parent render.
concepts.context: SearchBox.tsx lists [query, onResults]; if the parent passes an unmemoized onResults, the effect re-runs and re-debounces on every parent render

concepts.description: A form input whose value is held in React state and updated through onChange, making state the single source of truth.
concepts.context: SearchBox.tsx renders <input value={query} onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)} /> backed by useState
